messages:
ellie: Heads-up — we're getting ~13% fncall schema rejects for a particular tenant after validator v2.4. Same pattern: client sends an array where `tool_response.entry` expects an object.

sam: Is this the strict 'required' enforcement change?

ellie: Yep. Minimal failing sample pasted in thread — array instead of object. Frontend shows 5xx for that customer.

chris: Two immediate concerns: billing surprises and Console triage UX. I'd prefer a short-lived 'soft-validate' mode that auto-falls back for coercible diffs and suppresses billing.

marta: For Console: show inline validation code (e.g., ARR_OBJ), a sample link (hashed id), and a one-click toggle to enable soft-validate for that validator with a sampling slider. Also show estimated token cost delta.

sam: Implementation plan: 1) router: add `billing_mode=free_fallback` flag when heuristic says coercible, and emit `fncall.validation_outcome{status=warn|fail,code=ARR_OBJ,validator=v2.4}`, 2) validator: add small classifier for ARR_OBJ and SINGLETON_ARRAY, 3) Console: quick column + sample link. I can do 1&2 as a hotfix.

chris: Alerting: page when `validation_outcome{status=fail} > 1%` for 10m or when `status=warn` and fallback p95 latency > 2x. Sampling: 100% fails, 1% warns. Audit: store full failing sample in secure logs for 7d and reference it by hashed id in metrics.

marta: UX acceptance: Support can click sample -> see original JSON + validator diff + suggested actions (enable soft-validate / rollback validator).

deploy-bot: deploy started by sam for rev-router@hotfix -> env=prod shard=us-east-2

ellie: Thanks — will flip a 10% soft-validate canary after deploy and monitor `fncall.validation_outcome` for 30m.
